question: What is the appearance attributed to the left line?
premises: The left line is the subject being described.
Its appearance is likened to the china-rose and red lac.
The description is addressed to the fair-faced one.
inference: The left line is characterized as having the color or likeness of the china-rose and red lac.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, the left line resembles the china-rose and red lac.
